sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief:
"to issue a writ of Mandamus, declaring the action of the 4th and 5th respondents in laying the road in middle of the petitioners property to an extent of Ac.0.34 gts in Survey No.242/A (Ac.0.18 gts), Survey No.243 (Ac.0.08 gts) and Survey No.230/B (Ac.0.08 gts) situated at Orsu Revenue Village Shivar, Khila Warangal Mandal,
Warangal District,

without following due process of law, without issuing any notice or without paying any compensation as per the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 laying the 60 feet road in the petitioners land illegally without following due process of law is illegal and arbitrary.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Municipal Administration for respondent No.1, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue for respondent Nos.2 and 3, Sri P. Chandrasekhar Reddy, learned Standing Counsel for the respondent No.4 and Sri S. Surender Reddy, learned Standing Counsel for respondent No.5.
3.

When the matter is taken up for hearing, Sri P. Chandrasekhar Reddy, learned Standing Counsel for respondent JSR,J No.4 and Sri S. Surender Reddy, learned Standing Counsel for respondent No.5, basing on the oral instructions, informed this Court that respondent Nos.4 and 5 are not laying any road in the subject land.
4. In view of the same, no further orders are required to be passed in this Writ Petition.

Accordingly,
the writ petition is closed.
Miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE J. SREENIVAS RAO 1st June, 2023 PNS/FM JSR,J HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE J. SREENIVAS RAO WRIT PETITION No.13635 of 2023 1st June,
